opening.opening_summary: A Zerg versus Zerg opening that prioritizes economy and ground-based macro, with light or uncertain technology investment. The early game focuses on establishing a strong economy and expanding, while maintaining a moderate production of Zerglings and Queens. As the game progresses, the posture can transition to heavier ground forces (Roaches) or incorporate air units (Mutalisks) depending on the situation.
